summary: APPROVE: All rubric items pass. /entity/link accepts task↔entity and entity↔entity with correct guard (at least one side must be an entity). Task auto-wire fires at both creation and vec-ingest birth, scanning entity_nodes for name-as-substring in task label, calling addEntityEdge(..., 'touches'), fully best-effort (double-wrapped try/catch). GET /entity/:id/context returns {entity, facts, tasks, summary} with asOf temporal filter on facts and 404 on missing entity. entity_context MCP tool in lib/mcp-core.js does name→id lookup then calls context endpoint, read-only. Task creation path unbroken. Style clean and consistent. Extra scope in lib/overlay.js (entity model foundations), routes/graph.js (BM25/RRF search upgrade + entity-seeded expansion), and bench/agent-memory/distill.py (entity extraction) is substantively related and regression-safe — all additive.
